 FOR SUBSCRIBERS 2026 Election Obama urges Maryland to back a ballot measure to open the door for Democratic gerrymandering
 The state constitutional amendment would remove a provision that prevented Democrats from drawing a potential 8-0 congressional map in 2022. Listen to this article 00:00 00:00 Barack Obama in Chicago on June 18. Taylor Hill / Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 26, 2026, 6:00 AM EDT By Alexandra Marquez Former President Barack Obama urges Marylanders in a new ad out Monday to vote in favor of a ballot question that would allow state Democrats to draw a new congressional map for the next election cycle.
